overview_description.description:
Kingpin is the leading AI-powered global sales agency for consumer brands. We get your brand in front of 100 new retailers you chose, each month. At 0% commission.

Every brand hits the same two walls: finding new doors, and keeping the ones they've already won from going cold. Between them, 80% of a sales team's week disappears before a single meaningful conversation happens.

Kingpin runs both. We target the right retailers with live web research, verify every buyer contact before a single email goes out, and reach them with personalised, multi-language outreach sent from your own mailbox. You approve the list, and we replace anything you reject. Your catalogue gets digitised, your line sheets and per-buyer price lists get built, and every order gets captured across WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Excel.

The relationships stay yours. We never take a cut. Month one is risk-free and there is no lock-in.

Kingpin has facilitated $700M in GMV in 2025, works with 300+ brands and distributors, reaches 20,000+ retailers, and sells into 80+ markets. Backed by Infinity Ventures, COTU, Red Swan, Mu Ventures and Outliers.
